name: Selection

subjectOf.text: Because requesters select workers by reputation score, workers acquire an incentive to keep their scores high by performing tasks with high accuracy and efficiency.
subjectOf.abstract: Requesters can select workers based on their reputation score, giving workers an incentive to keep the reputation scores high by performing micro tasks with high accuracy and efficiency.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: requesters can observe and select on reputation score

subjectOf.text: Feng et al. (2025) show that verifier-selected synthetic data can prevent collapse, and the paper concedes the core of that result: verifier selection is an established remedy, and the oracle ceiling and the Gaussian setting are established.
subjectOf.abstract: Intelligence models increasingly learn from data that earlier Intelligence models produced, and when that loop repeats the rare cases disappear first. This paper preregisters a test of whether a reputation-weighted validator pool, filtering the training data of a recursive replacement loop, keeps those rare cases alive. The outcomes remain sealed until a replication of the original model-collapse result succeeds.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Can Reputation Prevent Model Collapse? A Preregistered Test of Reputation-Weighted Data Filtering (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7598518
scope_conditions: The result is prior work, not a finding of this study.
What this paper isolates is how to weight several assessors behind a validity filter, not whether verifier selection works.

subjectOf.text: Filters that select on surprise or entropy, not validity, work where they work because they see what a validity filter is forbidden to see, and against that literature a null here is a literature rather than a caveat.

scope_conditions: The comparison rests on published surprise-filter and entropy-filter results.
The paper runs no surprise or entropy arm, so it supplies no measured comparison with them.
